description: How well each of the given labels describes the clip, best first.

labels.description: Every given label, sorted by score, highest first.

score.description: Probability among the given labels (they sum to 1).

similarity.description: Cosine similarity between the clip and the label, -1 to 1; comparable across requests.

seconds.description: Length of the clip in seconds.

audio_embedding.description: The clip's 512-number unit-length embedding, when return_embedding is true.
